trireme.speaker: object
trireme.text: Trireme was galley ship used by the ancient civilizations of the Mediterranean Sea.

trireme.speaker: object
trireme.text: As a ship, it was fast and agile and was the dominant warship in the Mediterranean from the 7th to the 4th centuries BC.

trireme.speaker: object
trireme.text: The design of the trireme most likely pushed the technological limits of the ancient world.

trireme.speaker: object
trireme.text: It was important to achieve high speed and retain the ship's resistance to waves and the possible rollover.

trireme.speaker: object
trireme.text: The total complement of the ship was about 200.

trireme.speaker: object
trireme.text: These were divided into the 170 rowers, who provided the ship's motive power, the deck crew headed by the trierarch and a marine detachment.
